fact: Loi n°001-2021/AN, adopted 30 March 2021, bars administrative or private decisions resting solely on automated profiling (art. 15), requires disclosure of criteria where AI is used (art. 19), requires CIL authorisation for predictive-AI decision support (art. 31) and creates the CIL as control authority (art. 45).
title: Loi n°001-2021/AN portant protection des personnes à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel
